text:
The evidence can't tell us whether clearing is happening today. It only covers tree-cover loss in 2021, and the latest year observed in the series is 2025.

For 2021, Hansen/UMD mapped about 81.3 ha of tree-cover loss (2.23% of the 3,643.5 ha property). The JRC 2020 forest reference agrees on 98% of that area. The MGAP 2021 map shows most of it (68.1 ha) was planted pine (Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda). None was native forest, and 13.2 ha was outside mapped forest. Because Hansen counts any stand replacement, this loss may be plantation harvest rather than deforestation.

The evidence does not establish the cause, legality, or responsibility for the loss. It also does not support any compliance conclusion. Nothing here covers 2022–2025 or the present, so you would need data for those years to answer your question.
